    Calculate Pseudobulk and Variance Matrices for ORPHEUS

    calculate_orpheus_inputs.Rd

    This function takes a pre-processed Seurat object (ideally from `prepare_seurat_for_orpheus`) and calculates pseudobulk mean and variance matrices for specified groups (e.g., cell types). It can also generate pseudoreplicates within each group.

    calculate_orpheus_inputs(
  seurat_obj,
  groups_to_analyze,
  grouping_var,
  assay_to_use = "ORPHEUS_norm",
  cells_threshold = 10,
  num_replicates = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE,
  random_seed = 42
)

    Arguments

    seurat_obj

    A pre-processed Seurat object with globally normalized counts.

    groups_to_analyze

    A character vector of the group IDs to analyze (e.g., c("T cells", "B cells")).

    grouping_var

    The column name in the Seurat metadata that defines the groups (e.g., "celltype").

    assay_to_use

    The assay to use for calculations, which should contain the normalized counts (default is "ORPHEUS_norm").

    cells_threshold

    The minimum number of cells required per individual within a group (default is 10).

    num_replicates

    An integer specifying the number of pseudoreplicates to create per subject.

    verbose

    Logical indicating whether to print progress messages (default is TRUE).

    random_seed

    An integer seed for reproducibility when creating pseudoreplicates.

    Value

    A nested list where each element corresponds to a group and contains the pseudobulk matrix, variance matrix, and the filtered counts for that group.
